window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; several items describe operations from late October or early November, with dates stated in each story. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcements could be verified; the most recent tally found (USNI News, 5 October) put deaths at 238.

stories.summary: Agents at the San Clemente checkpoint in California's San Diego Sector stopped two vehicles on 25 October and found about 550 vacuum-sealed packages of suspected cocaine, valued…

stories.headline: Coast Guard cutter William Trump brings ashore about 3,600 pounds of cocaine from two Caribbean interdictions
stories.summary: The cutter's crew landed the haul on Wednesday 4 November, with the drugs valued near $27 million. Four detainees were handed to federal agents at Port Everglades, Florida.
